assets.name: bridge
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign ONLY the stone bridge from reference image 1 for the RPG map in reference image 2. Reference image 3 gives the ground-trail paving palette and pattern. The old bridge has a mistaken tall wall-like front and exposed piers: REPLACE that geometry. Create ONE straight east-west bridge seen from a MUCH HIGHER orthographic camera, about 75 to 80 degrees above the ground, almost overhead. No yaw and no isometric slant: both long edges and the east-west walking direction must remain exactly horizontal in the image. The huge broad flat TOP DECK must occupy at least 75 percent of the visible object height. Use irregular muted warm gray stone paving that matches the approach trail in reference 3, rather than neat tiny brick courses. Two very low narrow granite parapets at the north and south edges with sparse snow patches, NO posts at either endpoint. The deck is at exactly ground level at both ends and reaches flush to the left and right image edges: open unobstructed square ends without steps, plinths, curbs across the entrance, or dropoffs. The north and south parapets end flush at those same endpoints. Only a VERY THIN dark stone fascia is visible below the near parapet, at most 5 percent of the entire object height. No visible arches, no piers, NO legs, no support feet, no elevated wall below the deck. Final object proportions about 576 wide by 160 high, a long broad rectangular strip. Detailed but readable medieval RPG pixel art matching the existing muted alpine palette; crisp opaque pixels and actual transparent alpha outside the bridge. Fully visible isolated object with minimal margins. No ground islands, no road extensions, no ravine, no water, no characters, no text, no grid, no arrows, no background, no cast shadow. This is a playable bridge asset, not a perspective concept illustration. The top deck must clearly carry the ground trail straight across from left to right.

previous_versions.name: bridge

Create ONE complete long horizontal medieval granite bridge with three open arches on its south-facing side. Orthographic camera from due south looking north, pitched down 45 degrees, zero yaw, no isometric angle: long front and back edges exactly horizontal, end edges vertical in screen space. Wide 18:7 object silhouette. Its TOP walkable stone deck is straight level east-west and broad enough for a path, occupying upper third of image; low parapet along far north edge and near south edge; three deep open arches and rough granite supports beneath the near parapet. Bridge spans left to right edge of object with square accessible endpoints at the SAME screen y. Snow patches only on parapet caps, weathered slate-gray stone and muted brown mortar, dark crevices. Match detailed medieval alpine RPG sprite style with crisp pixels, restrained highlights, no outlines. Isolated on actual transparent alpha background, fully visible with small clear margins. NO ground plane, no water, no backdrop, no characters, no text, no labels, no grid, no drop shadow. Do not rotate or tilt the horizontal deck.

assets.name: gate
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art RPG map object for a 32px tile game. Create ONE complete ancient mountain shaman gateway: two thick weathered granite pillars, a heavy broad lintel, jagged snow-capped broken stone shoulders, faded subtle blue-gray carved abstract wards, tattered dull red cloth ties and small bone charms attached to outer pillars. Large clear EMPTY transparent central arch opening taking middle third of the entire width and extending down to ground, an unobstructed north-south walking passage. Orthographic camera due south looking north pitched down 45 degrees zero yaw, NOT isometric. Long lintel edges are exactly horizontal, symmetrical square frontal presentation. Proportions 12 wide by 9 high. Slate-gray granite, off-white snow, muted brown bindings and dull red accents. Match detailed medieval alpine RPG sprite style with crisp pixels, restrained highlights, no outlines. Isolated on actual transparent alpha, fully visible with small clear margins. No floor in opening, no closed door, no ground plane, no background, no characters, no readable text, no glow, no grid, no shadow beneath.

assets.name: broken_rope_end
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied pixel-art rope bridge section into ONE broken right-facing end of that same bridge. This is a horizontal east-west bridge, continued from the LEFT edge, ending in a ragged broken edge on the RIGHT. Preserve the same straight overhead RPG view, simple chunky pixel art, flat tan/brown palette and transparent background. Keep the full existing wood deck and the upper/lower rope at the left edge exactly aligned: deck fills most of the height, upper rope near one fifth of the height and lower rope near the bottom. Preserve the left quarter completely. In the right half, shorten the deck unevenly into splintered planks; tear both ropes so they curl and dangle into the transparent empty rightmost quarter. One or two loose tilted planks hang downward from the broken end. The entire right edge must be transparent. Do not add end posts, snow, scenery, text, lighting, shadows or a second bridge. Keep the original canvas proportions, with no added margins and no rotation of the intact bridge. Actual transparent alpha. The art will be normalized to exactly 64x96 pixels; keep details bold and readable at that size.
